executiveSummary.title: Executive Summary
executiveSummary.p1: AICreatesAi is building the world's first Agentic Business Operating System - a complete "Company in a Box" that enables every business owner to run a coordinated, intelligent, and continuously improving virtual company.
executiveSummary.p2: We are raising $50 million primarily to develop proprietary AI intelligence, advanced compute infrastructure, and the core operating system. The platform will deliver reliable business outcomes through a phased approach, with long-term ownership of our own AI models.
executiveSummary.p3: Key features include a desktop-native experience, closed-loop quality systems, agentic wallets with real user control, and a sustainable token economy designed to reward contributors.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.p1: Most small business owners and solopreneurs struggle to manage multiple complex functions without the resources of larger companies. Current AI tools are fragmented, unreliable for real business tasks, or require significant technical expertise. There is a clear need for a single, trustworthy system that acts like a real company - with intelligent coordination, quality control, and continuous improvement.

vision.title: Our Vision & Solution
vision.p1: AICreatesAi is creating a new category: the Agentic Business Operating System.
vision.p2: Our platform enables users to describe business goals in natural language and receive coordinated, high-quality execution across marketing, sales, finance, legal, operations, and development - with built-in quality review and continuous improvement.
vision.p3: We are executing a disciplined, phased strategy that delivers real value early while building long-term defensibility through data, product experience, and proprietary model development.

market.title: Market Opportunity
market.p1: The demand for AI-powered tools that genuinely help run businesses is growing rapidly. Our primary focus is on solopreneurs, small business owners, and service-based teams who need enterprise-grade capabilities without enterprise complexity or cost.

product.title: Product Overview
product.p1: AICreatesAi delivers a unified platform accessible through web, mobile, and a powerful native desktop experience.
product.l2: Automatic quality review and improvement systems
product.l3: Persistent business memory and context awareness
product.l6: Long-term development of proprietary AI models optimized for business use
product.p2: The $50M raise is dedicated to building the core AI intelligence, compute systems, and the "Company in a Box" operating system.

moat.listIntro: Our strategy focuses on several key advantages:
moat.l2: Closed-loop AI systems that improve output quality
moat.l3: Hybrid compute with strong privacy and performance foundations

gtm.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
gtm.p1: We will initially target solopreneurs and small business owners - the segment that benefits most from a unified, reliable system. Our approach emphasizes product-led growth, community building, and clear demonstration of real business outcomes.

tokenomics.p1: AICreatesAi Token ($AICA) is to support subscriptions, long-term ecosystem participation and contributor rewards as well as other utilities planned.
tokenomics.subTitle: Token Overview
tokenomics.l1: Core platform revenue will initially be driven by subscriptions to ensure operational stability then the use of the Token will be integrated where necessary.
tokenomics.l2: The token will provide utility through subscription discounts, participation in the compute network & rewards distributed to contributors. GPU, Data, etc.
tokenomics.l3: All tokens sold in private rounds will be subject to appropriate vesting schedules.

roadmap.title: High-Level Roadmap
roadmap.phase01Text: Build core platform, closed-loop quality systems, and initial workflows. Achieve early product-market fit.
roadmap.phase2Text: Expand capabilities, launch marketplace features, deepen proprietary model development, and scale user base.
roadmap.phase3Text: Scale intelligence and compute participation, deliver advanced autonomous capabilities, and grow ecosystem.

risks.title: Risks & Mitigations
risks.p1: We acknowledge the ambitious nature of this vision. Our phased approach, focus on quality systems, and emphasis on real user outcomes are designed to manage execution, technical, and market risks effectively.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.p1: AICreatesAi is building the operating system for the agentic era of business.
conclusion.p2: With a $50M raise focused on core AI intelligence, compute infrastructure, and the "Company in a Box" product, we are positioned to create a category-defining platform that delivers immediate value while building lasting competitive advantages.
